title: Implement page Wishlist
context: A shopper had no way to keep a product for later without putting it in the cart. Every product card now has a button that puts the product on a wishlist, and the same button takes the product off again. The header has a link to a new wishlist page, which shows one card for every product on the list. The list is kept in memory only, so a reload of the app empties it.
## Overview
- **When** a shopper opens any page, **then** [the header shows a "Wishlist" link to `/wishlist`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L13) after the "Account" link.
- **When** a shopper opens the catalogue, **then** [every product card shows a wishlist button](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#L13) after "Add to cart".
- **When** a product is not on the wishlist, **then** [its button says "Add to wishlist"](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#L10).
- **When** a shopper clicks "Add to wishlist", **then** [the button of that product says "Remove from wishlist"](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#L10).
- **When** a shopper opens `/wishlist` with no product on the wishlist, **then** [the page shows "Your wishlist is empty."](code:src/routes/wishlist/index.tsx#L6).

- **When** a shopper opens `/wishlist` with products on the wishlist, **then** [the page shows one product card per product](code:src/routes/wishlist/index.tsx#L8-14), in the order the shopper added them.
- **When** a shopper clicks "Remove from wishlist" on the wishlist page, **then** [the card of that product leaves the page](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L13-15).
- **When** a shopper reloads the app, **then** [the wishlist is empty again](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L10).
- **When** a shopper clicks "Add to cart", or opens the cart or the account page, **then** nothing changes below the header.

**`src/stores/wishlist-store.ts`**
- Added [`WishlistState`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#WishlistState), an interface with `products` and `toggleProduct`.

- Added [`useWishlistStore`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#useWishlistStore), a Zustand store that [starts with `products: []`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L10) and whose [`toggleProduct()` removes a product whose `id` is in `products` and appends any other product](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L11-17).

nodes.impactReason: [`<CatalogPage />` renders one `<ProductCard />` per product](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L10-14), and [each card now renders a `<WishlistButton />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#L13). [`<ProductCard />` renders `<WishlistButton />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#L13), and this pull request declares [the component](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#WishlistButton) in the same folder.

waypoints.title: Added the wishlist button to the product card
waypoints.reading: The author added an element to the component `<ProductCard />` that renders [`<WishlistButton />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#WishlistButton) after `<AddToCartButton />`, with the product of the card as its `product` prop. [`<CatalogPage />` renders one card per product of the catalogue](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L10-14) and [`<WishlistPage />` renders one card per wished product](code:src/routes/wishlist/index.tsx#L9-13), so that a shopper can put a product on the wishlist or take it off on both pages. The image, the name, the price and "Add to cart" are the same as before.

files.title: A store holds the wished products
summary: Added [`useWishlistStore`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#useWishlistStore), a Zustand store that [starts with `products: []`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L10) and whose [`toggleProduct()` removes a product whose `id` is in `products` and appends any other product](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L11-17).

Added [`selectIsWished()`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#selectIsWished), a function that [returns a function that returns `true` when `products` has a product with the id `productId`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L21).

waypoints.title: Added the imports of `create` and `Product`
waypoints.reading: The author added two imports that name `create` from `zustand` and the type [`Product`](code:src/types/product.ts#L1-6) from `@/types/product`. [`useWishlistStore` is the result of `create<WishlistState>()`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L9), and [`products` is a `Product[]`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L5).

waypoints.title: Added `WishlistState`, the shape of the wishlist store
waypoints.reading: The author added an interface `WishlistState` that has `products`, a `Product[]`, and `toggleProduct`, a function that takes a `Product` and returns nothing. [`useWishlistStore` is created with `WishlistState`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L9) and [the function that `selectIsWished()` returns takes a `WishlistState`](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L21). The store keeps whole products and not their ids, so that [`<WishlistPage />` passes each product to `<ProductCard />`](code:src/routes/wishlist/index.tsx#L11) with no request for the catalogue. The interface is not exported.

waypoints.title: Added `useWishlistStore` to hold the wished products
waypoints.reading:
The author added a Zustand store `useWishlistStore` that:

- starts with `products: []`
- removes the product from `products` when `toggleProduct()` gets a product whose `id` is in the array
- appends the product to the end of `products` when its `id` is not in the array

[`<WishlistButton />` calls `toggleProduct(product)` on a click](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#L9) and [`<WishlistPage />` reads `products`](code:src/routes/wishlist/index.tsx#L5), so that the button and the page share one list with no import between the two components. The store is a module-level value and `create()` gets no `persist` middleware, so a reload of the app starts again with `products: []`.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the rule the pull request exists for: one action appends a product whose `id` is not in `products` and removes a product whose `id` is. [`<WishlistButton />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#WishlistButton) and [`<WishlistPage />`](code:src/routes/wishlist/index.tsx#WishlistPage) call the action and show its result.

waypoints.title: Added `selectIsWished()` to read whether a product is wished
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `selectIsWished()` that takes a `productId` and returns a second function. The second function takes a `WishlistState`, and returns `true` when `products` has a product with that `id` and `false` when `products` has none. [`<WishlistButton />` passes `selectIsWished(product.id)` to `useWishlistStore`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#L6), so that each button reads one boolean for its own product and [shows "Remove from wishlist" for `true`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#L10).

journeyNodes.label: Renders the wishlist page at /wishlist
journeyNodes.description:
Two Entry Points reach this route table.

- When the app starts, `src/main.tsx` passes this route table to `<RouterProvider />` on line 16.
- When a shopper opens /wishlist, `<RouterProvider />` matches the address against this route table and [renders the element of the path `wishlist`](code:src/router.tsx#L16) inside [the `<RootLayout />` of the `/` route](code:src/router.tsx#L10-11).

journeyNodes.label: Renders the catalogue as product cards
journeyNodes.description: When a shopper opens /, [`router` renders this component at the index route of `/`](code:src/router.tsx#L13). The diff does not touch this component: it is the step between the address `/` and `<ProductCard />`.

children.label: Renders one product with a wishlist button
children.description:
Several Entry Points reach this component.

- When a shopper opens /, [`<CatalogPage />` renders this component once per product of the catalogue](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L10-14).
- When a shopper opens /wishlist, `router` renders `<WishlistPage />`, and [`<WishlistPage />` renders this component once per wished product](code:src/routes/wishlist/index.tsx#L9-13).

children.label: Renders a button that says "Add to wishlist" or "Remove from wishlist"
children.description:
Several Entry Points reach this component, all through `<ProductCard />`: [`<ProductCard />` renders this component with the product of the card](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#L13).

- When a shopper opens /, [`<CatalogPage />` renders one `<ProductCard />` per product of the catalogue](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L10-14).
- When a shopper opens /wishlist, [`<WishlistPage />` renders one `<ProductCard />` per wished product](code:src/routes/wishlist/index.tsx#L9-13), so `isWished` is `true` for every button on that page.

journeyNodes.label: Renders the wished products, or a note that there are none
journeyNodes.description: When a shopper opens /wishlist, [`router` renders this component at the path `wishlist`](code:src/router.tsx#L16), a child of the `/` route, so [the `<Outlet />` of `<RootLayout />`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L20) shows it under the header.

journeyNodes.label: Holds the wished products and adds or removes one
journeyNodes.description:
Several Entry Points reach this store.

- When a shopper opens /, `<CatalogPage />` renders `<ProductCard />`, `<ProductCard />` renders `<WishlistButton />`, and [`<WishlistButton />` reads `isWished` and `toggleProduct` from this store](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#L6-7).
- When a shopper opens /wishlist, `router` renders `<WishlistPage />`, and [`<WishlistPage />` reads `products` from this store](code:src/routes/wishlist/index.tsx#L5).
- When a shopper clicks "Add to wishlist" or "Remove from wishlist", [the `onClick` of the button calls `toggleProduct(product)`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#L9). The handler does not name this store: `toggleProduct` is the value that [`useWishlistStore((state) => state.toggleProduct)` returns](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#L7).

journeyNodes.label: Returns a function that returns true for a wished product
journeyNodes.description: When a shopper opens / or /wishlist, `<ProductCard />` renders `<WishlistButton />`, and [`<WishlistButton />` calls this function with `product.id` and passes the result to `useWishlistStore`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/WishlistButton.tsx#L6). The store then calls the returned function with its state.

waypoints.title: Added `<WishlistButton />` to toggle a product on the wishlist
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<WishlistButton />` that:

- reads `isWished` with `useWishlistStore(selectIsWished(product.id))`, and `toggleProduct` from the same store
- renders a `<Button>` with the variant `ghost` that calls `toggleProduct(product)` on a click
- shows "Remove from wishlist" when `isWished` is `true`, and "Add to wishlist" when `isWished` is `false`

[`<ProductCard />` renders one `<WishlistButton />` with the product of the card](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#L13), so that a shopper changes the wishlist from the catalogue and from [the wishlist page](code:src/routes/wishlist/index.tsx#L11). [`toggleProduct()` removes a product that `products` has and appends a product that `products` does not have](code:src/stores/wishlist-store.ts#L11-17), so one `onClick` does both.
